command.help:
**How Optimus works**
Every posted image is hashed and compared against this server's blocklist (and, if opted in, the shared global scam list). Matches either act automatically or land as a review card in your review channel, depending on `action_policy`. Global matches come as review cards — the shared list never bans or deletes on its own.

**Commands**
• `/setup` — create or link the private review channel (start here)
• `/scamhash review message:<link>` — act on a scam message by your policy (like right-click → Review as scam)
• `/scamhash add|remove|list|whitelist|unwhitelist|import|export` — the blocklist; `add` takes an image or a link (needs Manage Messages)
• `/config view|set` — every setting, each explained inline
• `/stats` — detection activity and database health
• `/queue [detection]` — reports still waiting on a moderator, oldest first; `detection:` reopens a decided card (needs Manage Messages)
• `/report` — any member can send a scam image to the mods by link/ID (same as right-click → Apps → Report scam to mods)
• `/delete_server_data` — admin-only full wipe (GDPR)

**Review card buttons**
Confirm scam · False positive · Dismiss · Ban uploader · Unban · Whitelist image — one press each, logged to the audit trail. Ban uploader and Unban need **Ban Members**; the rest need **Manage Messages**, and False positive only lifts a ban if you also have Ban Members. Adding someone to `mod_role` only lets them see the channel. Use *Dismiss* for a report that was simply mistaken: it clears the card without blocklisting or whitelisting anything, so a bad report cannot make an image permanently exempt from detection. On servers that opted in and are approved for global contribution, *Confirm scam* also casts this server's vote toward the shared scam list, and *False positive* revokes a bad global entry for everyone.

Full guide: <https://github.com/rafs2006/optimus/blob/main/docs/moderator-guide.md>
Privacy policy: <https://alexr-pplx.github.io/optimus/privacy>

config_help.sensitivity: How close an image must be to a known scam to match: lenient = near-exact only, strict = catches more edits but risks more false positives. Default: balanced.
config_help.action_policy: What happens on a confident match: none = log only, report_only = post a review card, delete = also delete the message, delete_ban = also ban the uploader. Default: report_only.
config_help.mod_queue_threshold: Matches at or above this confidence (0–1) become review cards; anything below it is ignored. Automatic action needs a higher confidence, set for the whole deployment. Default: 0.5.
config_help.review_channel: Where review cards are posted. Set it with /setup. Default: not set (cards cannot be delivered).
config_help.ban_purge_hours: When a ban is issued, how many hours of the user's recent messages to purge (max 168). Default: 24.
config_help.safe_mode: true pauses all automatic enforcement (report-only) — useful right after setup or during an incident. Default: false.
config_help.retention_days: How long detection records are kept before automatic deletion. Default: 30.
config_help.locale: Language for replies and review cards (en, sr). Default: en.
config_help.optin_global_db: true checks images against the shared cross-server scam list. Global matches create review cards and never ban; they are deleted on their own only for an uploader this server banned or confirmed in the last 10 minutes. Default: false.
config_help.optin_scan_bots: true also scans images posted by other bots and webhooks. Default: false.
